title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：rent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the father ① paid the rent that no neighbour in the house would have described, and he said the paying was the whole of the month. The ② rent, meaning the payment itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; rent, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of rent in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ rent at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Rent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the father said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rent was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the payment. The ⑥ rent, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; rent, he said, is either something you pay or the only word that means both payment and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ rent had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ rent of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of describing; rent, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rent I remember is the rent described in the letter, which closed in 1996 and is still described as the quietest in the house. ⑩ Rent, my mother said in 1998, is the only thing that improves by being described; all rent, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like payment. She said the burden was the honest half.

answers.why: pay the rent 意为“付这一笔租金”，1989 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯描述的一笔租金做了一遍。
rent 意为“租金”，指那笔租金本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
rent 意为“租金”，指老屋里每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
rent 意为“租金”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rent 意为“租金、负担”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔负担就是那件事的全部。
rent 意为“负担”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔租金，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rent 意为“租金”，指家书里写到、被描述的那一笔，到 1994 年这一笔成了家书里的一行。
rent 意为“租金之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的租金之事是一处老屋和三个月份的描述。
rent 意为“租金”，我记得的是家书里描述过的那一笔，1996 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一笔。
rent 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，租金是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的租金。
